description: This source file defines the 'WeightPackageServices' class which provides various static methods for handling shipment package operations such as setting package info, updating, deleting, completing packages, and saving package details within the 'org.apache.ofbiz.shipment.weightPackage' package.

classes.name: WeightPackageServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static services for managing weight-based shipment packages, including creation, update, deletion, and completion of package processing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets and validates package information including dimensions and weight, and creates a package line if conditions are met.

methods.name: updatePackedLine
methods.description: Updates package line details such as weight, dimensions, and shipment box type, with validation for input completeness.

methods.name: deletePackedLine
methods.description: Deletes a specific package line identified by its sequence ID.

methods.name: completePackage
methods.description: Finalizes a package by setting shipment and invoice IDs, UOMs, costs, and marking the package complete or handling warnings.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Completes the shipment process, confirming no items are pending shipment and updating the shipment status accordingly.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Saves all package info related to an order, handling potential errors during the process.
